meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在 claude-mem observer 任务里只说两种结果:无可记录内容时回 skip_summary;有可搜索单元时输出一条 observation(含标题、4–10 条事实与叙述)。
howto.when: 当你通过 Grok Bot 领取 claude-mem 的 observer 任务时接管;任务空闲、初始化或没有工具结果时,回 skip_summary。

say.text: 把这条 inbox 任务写成 outbox 文件
这条任务没有工具结果,直接回 skip_summary
把这次的搜索结果整理成一条 observation
say.note: 输出含标题与 4–10 条带路径事实的 XML

howto.what_en: After install, Claude only replies with one of two results inside claude-mem observer jobs: skip_summary when nothing is worth recording, or a single observation (title, 4–10 facts with paths, narrative). No prose.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you run claude-mem observer jobs via Grok Bot; on idle, init, or no tool results it returns skip_summary.

say_en.text: Write this inbox job to the outbox file
This job has no tool results, just return skip_summary
Turn this search result into one observation
say_en.note: Outputs XML with title and 4–10 facts
